name: data

scripts.perf: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings perf/m1-gate.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --expose-gc perf/m2-gate.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings perf/m3-replication.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --expose-gc perf/m4-budgets.ts
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --test api/*.test.ts kernel/*.test.ts ops/*.test.ts seam/*.test.ts conformance/*.test.ts render/*.test.ts jsx/*.test.ts devtools/*.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run perf
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p types && tsc -p types/tsconfig.jsx.json && tsc -p types/tsconfig.auto.json && tsc -p types/tsconfig.public.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck

description: Reactive data engine — sources, a closed delta algebra, incremental operators, native/wire subscriptions, and a DOM render layer, under the executable SCHEDULE timing contract. The substrate fero replicates over.
